title: Sloth
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- branch -->
  <rect x='4' y='62' width='92' height='9' rx='4.5' fill='#8B5A2B'/>
  <rect x='4' y='62' width='92' height='3.5' rx='1.75' fill='#B07A45'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='48' rx='24' ry='22' fill='#9C7A54'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='45' rx='18' ry='16' fill='#C4A47C'/>
  <!-- arms reaching up along branch -->
  <path d='M28 40 Q16 52 20 64 Q22 68 27 66 Q30 64 30 60 Q30 52 34 46 Z' fill='#8A6B48'/>
  <path d='M72 40 Q84 52 80 64 Q78 68 73 66 Q70 64 70 60 Q70 52 66 46 Z' fill='#8A6B48'/>
  <!-- claws on branch -->
  <rect x='19' y='63' width='2.5' height='7' rx='1.2' fill='#E8DCC8'/>
  <rect x='24' y='64' width='2.5' height='7' rx='1.2' fill='#E8DCC8'/>
  <rect x='76' y='64' width='2.5' height='7' rx='1.2' fill='#E8DCC8'/>
  <rect x='81' y='63' width='2.5' height='7' rx='1.2' fill='#E8DCC8'/>

  <ellipse cx='50' cy='26' rx='16' ry='14' fill='#C4A47C'/>
  <!-- face lighter mask -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='28' rx='11.5' ry='10' fill='#E8D4B8'/>
  <!-- eye patches dark -->
  <ellipse cx='44' cy='27' rx='4' ry='4.5' fill='#6B4E36'/>
  <ellipse cx='56' cy='27' rx='4' ry='4.5' fill='#6B4E36'/>

  <circle cx='44' cy='27' r='2' fill='#2A2A4A'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='27' r='2' fill='#2A2A4A'/>
  <circle cx='44.7' cy='26.3' r='0.7' fill='#FFF6E0'/>
  <circle cx='56.7' cy='26.3' r='0.7' fill='#FFF6E0'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='32' rx='2.5' ry='1.8' fill='#4A3222'/>
  <!-- mouth smile -->
  <path d='M46 35 Q50 38 54 35' stroke='#7A5A3C' stroke-width='1.3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- ears tufts -->
  <circle cx='35' cy='20' r='3' fill='#9C7A54'/>
  <circle cx='65' cy='20' r='3' fill='#9C7A54'/>
</svg>
